title: Add read-only supplier purchase exposure report
description: Add a read-only supplier purchase exposure report by aggregating existing Purchase Orders with the authoritative receipt and settlement linkage already used by Purchase Order progress. This is not a new accounts-payable ledger: do not create invoices, infer due dates, guess settlement links, add schema, or mutate finance records.
acceptance_criteria: The report groups Purchase Order exposure by supplier and currency without combining different currencies.
For each group and order, the report exposes ordered amount, authoritatively linked settled amount and linkage status using the existing progress/reconciliation rules.
Outstanding amount is calculated only where linkage completeness supports it; unknown or unlinked settlement exposure is shown separately and never converted into an authoritative payable balance.
Filters include supplier, currency, order date and linkage status, and normal report queries are bounded or paged without N+1 behavior.
The UI and documentation clearly distinguish this operational exposure view from an invoice-backed accounts-payable ledger or aging statement.
Unit/integration tests cover multiple suppliers, multiple currencies, fully linked, partially linked, unlinked and empty histories; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Open the supplier purchase exposure report and verify orders are grouped by supplier and currency with linked settlement amounts.
Filter for unknown or unlinked settlement exposure and verify it is not presented as an authoritative payable balance.

human_gate.reason: Read-only aggregation using existing Purchase Order progress and authoritative finance references; no payable schema, production mutation, deployment or release.
